title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 3 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
prompt: Countries are becoming more and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
scenario: Countries are becoming more and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
